name: Hotel Skansen
lede: On Sweden’s west coast, Hotel Skansen wanted the terraces of its new SAND restaurant and lounge used in the colder months, with even heat and a calm, luxurious feel. Eclipse Freestanding heaters hang their heads over the middle of the tables.
data: Resort hotel – SAND restaurant and lounge

hero.caption: Eclipse Freestanding over a dining table at dusk. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

photos.caption: Two Eclipse heaters over the sofas along the courtyard wall. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.
The Eclipse disc and its LED ring. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

beats: Hotel Skansen in Båstad, run by GRAM Group, has more than 172 rooms, conference centres, a spa with a cold bathhouse and a rooftop banquet hall. Its new SAND restaurant and lounge open onto outdoor seating.
The hotel wanted its outdoor areas usable in colder months without losing the ambience its guests expect. Even distribution of heat was the priority.

After reviewing plans and images, Bromic recommended Eclipse Freestanding: each heater head hangs from a mounting arm over the middle of a table, and the heaters can be moved to where they are needed. Staff run them with wireless controls.

quote.text: We use them with wireless controls, which work very well.
